answer: Dynamic Routing Congestion Tax allocates network bandwidth through an automated market maker. When an agent requests message priority across the opal network, the protocol measures local traffic density to compute a geometric transmission toll. Each active connection acts as a refractive prism, scattering connection requests and multiplying latency penalties exponentially with every concurrent duplicate spawned by the same origin node. An attacker attempting to flood the system finds their operational throughput choked on every isolated island of the topology,
